name: @vegaduta/clients-shared
description: Shared core for the VegaDuta IDE/browser plugins: API client, SSE reader, OIDC device-flow auth, host<->webview protocol, chat webview bundle, and the on-device (WebLLM/Ollama) engine layer. Not published - clients/vscode and clients/chrome import ../shared/src by relative path and bundle it themselves; clients/jetbrains consumes only the built webview bundle (dist/webview).
